definitions.gloss: theorem; established mathematical or logical truth
definitions.explanation: A statement in mathematics or logic that has been proven to be true through rigorous logical reasoning from axioms and previously established results.

examples.japanese: {定理|ていり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}する→証明する：17851_shoumeisuru⟧。
ピタゴラス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定理|ていり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{定理|ていり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{数学|すうがく}→数学：01442_suugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{応用|おうよう}→応用：04135_ouyou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This theorem is applied in many fields of mathematics.

notes:
Composed of {定|てい} (established/fixed) and {理|り} (principle/logic). The fundamental unit of proven knowledge in mathematics and formal logic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定理|ていり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{証明|しょうめい}する→証明する：17851_shoumeisuru⟧: to prove a theorem
- {定理|ていり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{応用|おうよう}する→応用する：25373_ouyousuru⟧: to apply a theorem
- ピタゴラス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定理|ていり}: the Pythagorean theorem
- {二項|にこう}{定理|ていり}: the binomial theorem
- {中間値|ちゅうかんち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定理|ていり}: the intermediate value theorem

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {公理|こうり}: axiom — a statement accepted as true without proof, serving as a starting point
- ⟦{法則|ほうそく}→法則：05143_housoku⟧: law / rule — a general principle, especially in natural sciences (e.g., Newton's laws)
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧: formula — a mathematical expression or equation, not a proven statement
- ⟦{命題|めいだい}→命題：21556_meidai⟧: proposition — a statement that may or may not be proven, broader than {定理|ていり}
